def absolute_checked(desc, root):
    supplied = Path(desc["file"])
    require(supplied.is_absolute() and not supplied.is_symlink(), "Absolute actual model input")
    path = supplied.resolve(strict=True)

def lift_finite64_word(word):
    """Exact representation inclusion, not a numerical64-to128 rounding."""
    sign = (word >> 63) << 127
    exponent = (word >> 52) & 2047
    fraction = word & ((1 << 52)-1)
    if exponent == 2047:
        raise ValueError("A nonfinite binary64 model word cannot be a finite128 column")
    if exponent:
        return sign | ((exponent-1023+16383) << 112) | (fraction << 60)
    if not fraction:
        return sign
    leading = fraction.bit_length()-1
    exponent128 = leading-1074+16383
    fraction128 = (fraction-(1 << leading)) << (112-leading)
    return sign | (exponent128 << 112) | fraction128
